tailMarker.anomalyNote: Resolved by the letter of §3.1 but structurally contested. Rank 8 > 3, and a conditioning ingredient does precede the marker (Myristyl Alcohol @3, a long-chain fatty alcohol named in R1's list), so neither §3.1 anomaly condition is met. However, no cationic surfactant of any kind precedes the marker, and this is a low-water solvent architecture (Propylene Glycol @1, Alcohol denat. @2, Aqua only @5) in which a fragrance level above 1% is entirely plausible. A reviewer who read 'conditioning ingredient' as 'cationic conditioning agent' would set tail_marker: unresolved. See AP-02-BONDTAIL for both readings and their consequences.  ||  PLAUSIBILITY ASSESSMENT (R2, §3.1.1, added under v0.2): IMPLAUSIBLE - tail_marker is UNRESOLVED. Both limbs of the test fire. Limb 1 (architecture comparison): the marker PARFUM @8 outranks every cationic species in the formula - CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @9 is the only cationic surfactant and sits below the marker, as do CETYL ALCOHOL @15 and LAURYL ALCOHOL @14 - so the marker sits before the architecture it is supposed to bound. Limb 2 (low-water / non-emulsion architecture): PROPYLENE GLYCOL @1, ALCOHOL DENAT. @2 and AQUA only @5 is a solvent-continuous, low-water system in which the ~1 % band the marker proxies does not sit where an O/W emulsion's does. Consequences, binding in both directions (§3.1.1 clauses 1-5): the marker may neither disqualify nor qualify; confidence on every affected field is capped at moderate; every affected call routes to human review under `tail_marker_unresolved`; and `unresolved` never auto-decides toward a value. v0.1's AP-02-BONDTAIL recorded exactly this reading as the contested alternative; R2 makes it the rule.

Both paths agree, so the value is robust to the marker question. E2 ceiling: comparative structural intensity potential.
evidenceSignals: MYRISTYL ALCOHOL (rank 3) — long-chain fatty alcohol named in R1's list, at rank 3 of the full list: S2 satisfied on the ordinal read and independent of the marker
DICAPRYLYL CARBONATE (4) + CAPRYLIC/CAPRIC TRIGLYCERIDE (7) — two distinct non-fatty-alcohol lipids, both light-band: S3 satisfied on the ordinal read

CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE (rank 9) — the formula's only cationic surfactant. Under §3.1.1 clause 1 it is read on its own merits rather than disqualified by an unreliable marker; one distinct species either way, so S1 fails under every reading

PARFUM (rank 8) — marker UNRESOLVED: it outranks every cationic and fatty-alcohol species in the formula, on a low-water solvent-continuous architecture (PROPYLENE GLYCOL @1, ALCOHOL DENAT. @2, AQUA @5)
conditioningLevel.derivation: §9.1 under an unresolved marker. S1 = NOT satisfied under either reading (one cationic species exists in the entire formula). S2 = satisfied. S3 = satisfied. thresholdReasoning: Clears `moderate`: two convergent routes to the same value (the S1-mandatory rule, and the material-counter-signal cap).
`high` does not apply: S1 fails, and the marker is unresolved — either condition alone forecloses it under R3.
`low` does not apply: S2 and S3 both hold on the ordinal read.
§3.1.1 clause 5 observed: `unresolved` decided nothing here in either direction; it capped confidence and routed the record to review.
counterSignals: `tail_marker: unresolved` (§3.1.1) — MATERIAL counter-signal (a): the above-tail segment the signals were counted on is not reliable. Field listed in `uncertain_fields` and routed under `tail_marker_unresolved`.
Both S3 lipids are light-band esters/triglycerides; this is thin lipid breadth by mask standards, recorded even though S3 is a breadth test rather than a weight test.
Claims '100% stärkeres Haar' and '7x weniger Haarbruch' have no architecture behind them in the credited segment — recorded in `hinweise`, moving nothing (§11 step 4).

adjudicationPoints.title: The two readings of the unresolved marker, recorded side by side — the conservative one is applied
adjudicationPoints.body: R2 makes the marker `unresolved`; it may neither qualify nor disqualify, and it never auto-decides. Two coherent readings of this formula remain, and a human must choose. READING A (conservative, APPLIED): the gluconamide pair HYDROXYPROPYLGLUCONAMIDE @11 + HYDROXYPROPYLAMMONIUM GLUCONATE @12 sits ordinally below PARFUM @8 and is not credited. bond_route `none`, repair_support_level `low`, primary_focus `general`, care_direction `moisture`, all at moderate confidence and all routed to review. READING B (architecture-first): in a low-water solvent system the ~1 % band does not sit where the Parfum does; the pair is the product's named bonding technology, declared as a pair exactly as the Ashland FiberHance system is supplied, and it sits above the keratin and the two secondary fatty alcohols. On reading B, bond_route becomes `gluconamide`, repair_support_level becomes `high`, damage_fit becomes {moderately_damaged, highly_damaged}, and `repair` becomes a live step-3 focus candidate. The spread between the two readings is the widest in the cohort — it moves four fields including both extremes of repair_support_level. §1.1 requires the conservative value while the input is untrustworthy, so reading A is applied; §14's `tail_marker_unresolved` trigger exists precisely because the remedy is a human reading the architecture, not a fuller capture. Note the asymmetry with #04, which carries the identical pair at ranks 8 and 9 against a plausible marker at 13 and is credited without argument.

adjudicationPoints.title: The cohort's only `lightness` selection is withdrawn, on the readability rule rather than on the architecture
adjudicationPoints.body: v0.1 selected `lightness` as this product's primary focus — the one selection of that value anywhere in the cohort, and the answer §18 open question 4 was watching for. Under v0.2 it is withdrawn, because `lightness` requires `weight_potential: low` and R4 makes `low` a positive leanness test that §9.2 declares unavailable on an unreadable above-tail segment. The product is still, on any substantive reading, the lightest thing in the cohort: a solvent-continuous express serum with no butter, no heavy triglyceride, no occlusive and no silicone. So the answer to 'is lightness ever selected in this category' is now: not on this cohort, and not because the architecture failed the test but because the marker did. That is the conservative-failure invariant working as designed (§1.1: an absence-based `low` would hand a fine-hair prior to a formula we cannot read), but it means the field's reachability is entirely untested by this run and must be carried into the freeze gate.
